 Cuca could start Santos’ marquee signings together for the first time 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Coach Cuca could, for the first time this season, start Santos ’ marquee signings together against Coritiba . The 35th-round match is on 18 at 19:30 at Couto Pereira in Curitiba.
 With midfielder Gabriel Bontempo away with Brazil, who face Japan on 14 and Singapore on 17, Cuca is set to tweak his creative unit. According to Globo.com, Arthur is in line to step in after a thigh injury and a return off the bench against Bragantino.
 OneFootball Videos
 That would unite Arthur, Everton Cebolinha, Neymar , Coutinho and Gabigol in the starting XI.
 Neymar is available after the STJD reduced his suspension for a red card against Bahia. A key figure in Arthur’s arrival, via his company’s help with the transfer ban payment, the number 10 has not yet played alongside his friend.
 Cuca is also awaiting reinforcements in defence after a run of injuries that has repeatedly reshaped his back line. Goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão is unlikely to feature again this season following left-shoulder surgery, while the involvement of Escobar and Willian Arão is anticipated.
 Escobar’s thigh issue sidelined him for the last four matches, with Barreal covering. The Argentine then injured his right thigh against Bragantino and will not play again this year.
 Willian Arão also had a right thigh problem, is set to begin his on-grass transition and could make the squad, which would move João Alencar back to the bench.
 Source: Globo.com
